limits: Penalty density1e7 N/m3 is hypothetical, not measured or fitted material.
Material torus surface quadrature has no active-cell force renormalization; coarse samples can miss contact entirely.
Finite straight sidewall and top/bottom caps use source SDF gradients; entry wraps, deep/cavity and gradient-tie contacts stop as unknown.
No friction, belt motor, cassette dynamics or spring equilibrium is implemented in this standalone law.
Actual positive-side translation convention is sourced, but all comparison fixtures keepu=0. No negative-side moving-cassette qualification.
Indexed state is a diagnostic fixture: new potential minus inherited reservoir is exposed, not hidden by a reference shift.
A fresh acquisition from no contact under the same new law is required before claiming continuous handoff.
